description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget representing a dashboard page with various statistical cards, distributions, and progress indicators. It uses Provider for dependency injection to fetch Firestore and authentication state, and displays real-time data via streams.

classes.description: Widget representing a styled card with a title, value, and a child widget showing progress or distribution.
